name: Honda XR50R / XR70R
engine: 49 or 72 cc air-cooled four-stroke single, carb, automatic clutch
intro: Honda's kids' dirt bikes. Three or four speeds, no clutch lever, and very simple to keep running.
recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Honda dealer to run the VIN as well.
